images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: small photographic service card image for Vivimoves, a French workplace wellbeing website. Generate ONE standalone landscape photograph, 4:3, not a collage. Luminous natural daylight, inviting warm cream, oak and sand with subtle ochre, realistic architectural and material details. Simple readable composition for a small 768x576 website image, uncluttered with comfortable crop margins. STRICTLY NO PEOPLE: no humans, body parts, silhouettes, human shadows, printed portraits or people in mirrors, glazing or reflections. No readable text, lettering, branding, logos, watermark, labels, UI or borders. Any notebooks or presentation surfaces are completely blank.
Primary request: an EMPTY OUTDOOR SETTING AT A FRENCH FERME prepared for a team mini-retreat, with EXERCISE MATS LAID FLAT ON THE GROUND. A modest authentic warm limestone farmhouse and weathered timber barn doors frame a sunlit farm courtyard or flat grass verge. Four sand and muted terracotta exercise mats are visibly unrolled and spaced naturally on a clean flat short-grass area in the foreground, each with a simple cork block at one end. Low diagonal wide view: show the mats clearly, the rustic farmhouse architecture in the middle ground, and a broad patch of pale blue sky above. Bright gentle late-morning daylight, peaceful rural atmosphere, a little meadow vegetation at the edges, no dense forest, no decorative plant jungle. The place should read as a welcoming countryside ferme, not a luxury spa or a city rooftop. No people, animals, vehicles or machinery, no indoor room. Realistic safe level ground and restrained practical setup.
